item.title: Birmingham warming stations opening up for the weekend
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) -- This weekend’s extreme cold has those without housing or sufficient heat at home looking for ways to stay warm. Birmingham has two official warming stations: one run by the Jimmie Hale Mission and one run by Pathways. At Pathways, they’re setting up cots for women and children. item.title: Pepper Place Farmers Market opens 26th season despite freezing temperatures
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) — Despite freezing temperatures, the Pepper Place Farmers Market opened its 26th season Saturday, drawing crowds eager to support local vendors and reconnect with the community. The market kicked off its 2026 winter season, continuing its long-standing mission of bringing people together while giving farmers a consistent place to sell their goods [...]
